summary: Conservative plan to replace 'simulated'/'placeholder' occurrences with production-ready scaffolds or clear gating. All changes are dry-run by default and require manual review before enabling live apply.

entries.proposed_change: Replace simulated HTTP responses with a small pluggable adapter that calls configured AI model endpoint when QMOI_ALLOW_NETWORK=true; otherwise return a deterministic canned response. Add Vault-based secret lookup and telemetry for calls.
entries.rationale: Make the local test server usable in production while preserving dry-run behaviour and secret gating.

entries.proposed_change: Replace the simulated user-facing message with a configurable template and wire to TelephonyAdapter (dry-run) that logs call attempts to .qmoi_validation/calls.log. Keep an opt-in gating env var TELEPHONY_ENABLED.
entries.rationale: Avoid surprising end-users with 'simulated' messages; provide a real message path and clear gating for enabling live calls.

entries.proposed_change: Introduce a provider adapter (providers/image_api.py) that supports a 'local' mode (simulated files) and 'remote' mode using QMOI_AI_ENDPOINT; write outputs to artifacts/ and log to .qmoi_validation/ai_actions.json.
entries.rationale: Enable switching between fast local simulation and real remote providers with consistent logging.

entries.proposed_change: Keep the simulate return for dry-run plans. Remove stray single-token 'simulated' lines if present. Ensure all logs are written to .qmoi_validation/aws_autoclone.log and that autoclone remains gated by PRODUCTION_CONFIRMED & MASTER_TOKEN.
entries.rationale: This file is explicitly gated; we only remove accidental stray tokens and keep simulated behaviour intact.

entries.match: API endpoints for dashboard widgets (simulated, to be implemented in actual server)
entries.proposed_change: Add optional Flask dashboard stub generator (already implemented) and wire the automation to write the API stub to tools/dashboard_stub.py when QMOI_GENERATE_API_STUB=true. Add tests that validate stub generation.
entries.rationale: The automation already has a stub generator; ensure tests and docs exist and remove 'simulated' tag from comments.

entries.proposed_change: Update test name and logs to indicate 'dry-run simulated' and add skip markers when AWS creds are not present. Keep test fast and non-destructive.
entries.rationale: Improve clarity and safety for CI.

entries.match: Simulated device launch and feature check
entries.proposed_change: Replace simulated pass messages with a TestAdapter that records expected checks into .qmoi_validation/auto_lint_checks.json. Provide an --apply flag that would run real device commands (gated).
entries.rationale: Make post-install verification reproducible and auditable.

entries.proposed_change: Convert simulated error throws into a TestHarness that can emit controlled synthetic errors to the error-reporting pipeline; include a --simulate flag so behavior is explicit.
entries.rationale: Avoid accidental accidental exceptions in non-test contexts.
